canDo.en: I can greet someone new and clarify a short question.

canDo.de: Ich kann meinen Namen und meine Herkunft nennen und den Namen meines Gegenübers bestätigen.
canDo.en: I can say my name and where I am from, and confirm the other person's name.

canDo.ko: 찾는 물건의 이름을 말하고 어디 있는지 물을 수 있어요.
canDo.de: Ich kann sagen, was ich suche, und fragen, wo es ist.
canDo.en: I can say what I am looking for and ask where it is.

canDo.de: Ich kann ein Gericht und die gewünschte Menge bestellen.

canDo.de: Ich kann nach einer Uhrzeit fragen und sie noch einmal bestätigen.
canDo.en: I can ask about a meeting time and confirm it.

canDo.en: I can ask about a natural way to stay in touch, such as KakaoTalk, and confirm it.

canDo.en: I can ask and say where something is at home.

canDo.en: I can apologize right away for a small accident and ask if the other person is okay.

canDo.en: I can briefly ask and answer about favorite music or shows.

canDo.en: I can ask if an item is available and choose something else if it is not.

canDo.en: I can greet someone and exchange basic information in my first class.
